targets.query:
SELECT Final
FROM (SELECT SUM("FT-0303 Inlet Flow") / 60 AS Final FROM "mqtt" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1h, 0m))

SELECT
  last("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg") AS "Hourly Flow FIT 600-01"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1h, 0m) fill(null)

SELECT
  last("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg") AS "Hourly Flow FIT 600-02"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1h, 0m) fill(null)
